summary: Completed comprehensive testing of God's Lifting International School website. All core features are working correctly including homepage, admin login, bank details API, payment page, and admission form. Backend APIs are 95.5% functional with 21/22 tests passing. Frontend UI loads correctly with working navigation and user interactions.
